publication_status: G01 through G03 are accepted on main. G03 — COMPLETE at merge 8d6844ebdc1fd6eedf41373d53ad36eb399cc489. G04A — active implementation on feat/g04a-lossless-compress; G04A is not accepted or complete.

production_operation.ordering: One UI row, database ordinal, physical workspace snapshot and qpdf --file argument per input ordinal.
production_operation.output: One independently verified page-only PDF published without overwrite.
boundaries: No viewer behavior mixed into the accepted G02 merge flow

viewer.renderer: pdfjs-dist 6.2.108 legacy ESM API and worker
viewer.transport: Opaque retained-handle session with raw bounded Tauri range IPC
viewer.persistence: Ephemeral; no thumbnails or extracted text in SQLite
viewer.replacement: Candidate sessions validate transactionally while the active document remains usable; failed candidates are disposed without replacing active state.
viewer.assets: Exact checked-in 6.2.108 manifest, independent size/hash/membership verification, and atomic owned-directory replacement.
viewer.render_limits: DPR 2, 8192x8192 axes, 16,777,216 pixels, and fail-closed invalid/extreme page handling.
viewer.visibility: Mounted overscan is distinct from measured viewport visibility and cannot define the current page.

database_policy: Metadata only; document bodies and extracted content are prohibited.
